title: Agent Challenge Day
description: A human-centred workshop focused on identifying, designing and pitching Agentforce use cases aligned to customer business challenges.

title: Becoming an Agentic Enterprise
description: A strategic session exploring how organisations can move from AI ideation to enterprise-wide implementation.

title: Agent Flight
description: A modular, implementation-focused workshop that helps customers move from AI strategy into the practical realities of delivering, scaling, and governing AI agents in the enterprise.

title: Prompt Builder Workshop
description: A hands-on workshop designed to develop prompt engineering skills and build practical solutions using Prompt Builder.

title: Agentforce Ideation
description: A collaborative workshop that helps organisations identify, prioritise, and shape high-value Agentforce use cases aligned to real business problems.

title: Agentforce Hands-on Workshop
description: A hands-on technical workshop that enables teams to design, build, and test AI agents using Agentforce capabilities, including instructions, actions, and evaluation.

title: Data 360 Ideation
description: A collaborative workshop focused on identifying high-value data use cases and aligning them to customer priorities.

title: Data Readiness
description: A workshop focused on preparing data foundations required for successful AI and Agentforce deployments.

title: Roundtable Roulette
description: A highly interactive, facilitated discussion format that turns large-group conversations into open dialogue where everyone has a voice.

title: Agent Bar
description: A bookable, one-to-one working session where customers bring their Agentforce challenges and work through them with an expert.
